mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, sequence_no, message_type, payload_version, payload_json, compacts_through_sequence, created_at FROM session_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY sequence_no ASC

SELECT id, session_id, sequence_no, message_type, payload_version, payload_json, compacts_through_sequence, created_at FROM session_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND sequence_no > #{afterSequence} AND message_type <> 'COMPACTION' ORDER BY sequence_no ASC

SELECT id, session_id, sequence_no, message_type, payload_version, payload_json, compacts_through_sequence, created_at FROM session_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND message_type = 'COMPACTION' ORDER BY compacts_through_sequence DESC, sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1
